issues.title: MPAndroidChart 4.0.0 and a fresh start for the issue tracker

latest_release.name: MPAndroidChart 4.0.1
latest_release.body:
Fixes and small additions for MPAndroidChart 4.0. A drop-in update from 4.0.0: no API was removed or changed.

```kotlin
implementation("com.github.PhilJay.MPAndroidChart:MPChartLib:v4.0.1")
implementation("com.github.PhilJay.MPAndroidChart:MPChartCompose:v4.0.1") // only for Compose
```

## Fixed

- A tap inside a bar of a combined chart selects the bar instead of a nearby line point (#5207).
- In a bar chart whose grouped data sets use different y axes, a tap selects the bar that was touched (#5292).
- Limit line labels at the edge of the content area are no longer cut off (#5328).
- Auto scaling also rescales a y axis that is disabled (#5258).
- Charts can be built on a thread without a Looper, for example with an asynchronous layout inflater (#5241).
- The default value formatter no longer rebuilds its number format when the number of decimals stays the same (#5217).

## New

- `YAxis.labelRotationAngle` rotates the y axis labels (#5213).
- Pie entry labels and values with a line break are drawn as several lines (#5205).
- `PieChart.isRoundedSlicesReversed` rounds the slice ends the other way around (#5206).
- `PieChart.isTransparentCircleClippedToSlices` draws the translucent ring only over the slices, so the space between slices stays open (#5348).
- `chart.toBitmap(width, height)` draws a chart at any size, also one that was never laid out, for example to export an image (#4664).

The [guides](https://philjay.cc/mpandroidchart/docs/) cover all additions, and [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/PhilJay/MPAndroidChart/blob/v4.0.1/CHANGELOG.md) lists every change.
